bio.text: Ritchie Whorton represents House District 22, covering eastern Madison County and western Jackson County, in the Alabama House of Representatives, to which he was elected on November 4, 2014.

According to the legislature's profile, he is a longtime resident of Owens Cross Roads, graduated from New Hope High School in 1978 and earned a bachelor's degree from Jacksonville State University in 1983.
The profile states that since 1994 he and a business partner have operated All Star Pools.
